subject: Single-line VAT tagging and staged manual-push fallback for AP
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: AP Team <ap@acme-logistics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 26 Sep 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Single-line VAT tagging and staged manual-push fallback for AP

Hi Julia / AP Team,

Following our call this morning, attaching the VAT mapping workbook (acme_vat_mapping.xlsx) and a short proposal so we can align on the easiest path for your AP system. TL;DR: we can emit a single consolidated VAT line at the invoice level (one VAT total per invoice) to match your current AP ingest, and run a short canary where we also include line-level VAT in a parallel XML payload for systems that accept it. If your ERP requires separate VAT on each line item, we can instead enable a manual-push PDF fallback while we iterate on XML.

Proposed next steps (short):
- You confirm whether your AP will accept an invoice with a single VAT total (invoice-level) or requires line-level VAT.
- If invoice-level is acceptable, confirm the VAT tag name you expect (we’ve mapped common tags in tab "TagMap" of the workbook).
- If not, we’ll schedule a canary: Redwood sends both single-line VAT XML and a line-item VAT XML for the same invoice for 5 invoices so your team can test ingest.
- Fallback: if XML cannot be modified within your timeline, we can enable a daily manual PDF push (SFTP or email) for up to 30 days while engineering implements XML changes.

Attachments: acme_vat_mapping.xlsx (mapping of common VAT tags we can emit), sample_invoice_xml_v2.xml (example payload) — I uploaded both to the Drive link below.

Please confirm which route you prefer and any deadlines we should meet. Happy to jump on a short 20-minute session to walk the mapping.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Finance Integrations
Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: acme_vat_mapping.xlsx (spreadsheet)
---

From: Julia Park <julia.park@acme-logistics.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: AP Team <ap@acme-logistics.com>
Date: Tue, 26 Sep 2028 11:03:22 -0700
Subject: Re: Single-line VAT tagging and staged manual-push fallback for AP

Mina — thanks for the clear note and the mapping. Quick answers below.

We cannot ingest a single consolidated VAT total into our current EDI/ERP pipeline — our PO reconciliation requires VAT broken out per line (we have a validation that fails when VAT is only present at invoice level). That said, we can accept a manual PDF push as a temporary measure while you deliver line-level XML.

Questions: 
- On the canary you mentioned, will the duplicate payloads (single-line + line-level) use the same invoice number (so we can compare ingestion results)?
- If we go with the manual PDF push fallback, can you confirm expected filename convention and whether the PDF will include a VAT summary table?

We can do a 20-minute call tomorrow 09:30 PT if that helps — I’ll put a tentative slot on the calendar.

Julia Park
AP Manager, Acme Logistics

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Julia Park <julia.park@acme-logistics.com>; Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 26 Sep 2028 15:20:45 -0700
Subject: Re: Single-line VAT tagging and staged manual-push fallback for AP

Thanks Julia — helpful context. A couple of follow-ups from the Redwood ops/engineering side: 

1) Canary approach we recommend:
   - Redwood will emit both payloads using the same invoice_number and a canary flag (canary=true) in the XML header so your team can correlate records without touching production validation rules.
   - We’ll send 5 invoices during a 48-hour window and ask your team for ingest logs for those invoice_numbers.

2) Manual PDF fallback (if needed):
   - File naming: ACME_INV_{invoice_number}_{yyyymmdd}.pdf
   - PDF will include a VAT summary table and the line-level amounts so your AP team can validate totals.

3) Implementation: I’ve attached sample_invoice_xml_v2.xml with both invoice-level VAT and explicit line-level VAT blocks — we can toggle a flag in our generation pipeline. If you confirm the tag names in the workbook, we can produce a build for your test environment by EOD Wednesday (2028-09-27).

Connor — can you confirm whether the generation toggle and canary flag are ready for a Wednesday test push? If you prefer, we can push to a sandbox SFTP first.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Payments Product
Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: sample_invoice_xml_v2.xml (example payload with both VAT variants)

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>; Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 27 Sep 2028 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Single-line VAT tagging and staged manual-push fallback for AP

Marissa / Mina — confirmed. Engineering can enable the canary toggle and produce the test build tomorrow morning. Action items I’ve scheduled: 

1) Wednesday 09:00 PT — deploy test build to sandbox that emits both payloads with canary flag.
2) Wednesday 09:15 PT — push 5 sample invoices to Acme sandbox SFTP (ACME_INV_1001..1005).
3) Thursday 10:00 PT — sync call to review ingest logs (Julia to share).
4) If Acme’s validation fails, enable manual PDF push fallback for up to 30 days; Mina to confirm acceptance via email.

I’ll post the sandbox SFTP creds in the secure drive link and update the DocuSign envelope once we finalize the PO amendment for the manual-push SLA.

Connor O'Brien
Platform Reliability
Redwood Inference
